experiments.mechanism: Selected weighted-value body with explicitly modeled BF16 conversion; input quantization, FP32 accumulation and output rounding separated from attention approximation.

conditions.execution: selected unchanged weighted-value body with software FP32 FMA lanes and conversion model; no SIMD conversion/FBGEMM runtime
conditions.oracle: Independent arithmetic BF16 decoding, FP64 weighted sums of identical quantized inputs and finite rounding by exponent/step; fixed literal conversion-bit expectations.
conditions.conversion: Pinned AVX512 converter model: unsigned raw FP32 bits plus 0x8000 then shift 16; finite ties away from zero, not ties to even. Exceptional payload cases record literal archived behavior.
conditions.accumulation: Source-order FP32 fused multiply-add observed before output conversion; exact same-order FP32 equality plus independent FP64 absolute bound (nnz+1)*float_epsilon*sum_abs+1e-12.
conditions.output_rounding: Bit-exact agreement with independent finite arithmetic rounding oracle; output canaries unchanged.

experiments.note: Support for supplied weights and quantized values only. Conversion is explicitly emulated from pinned source; this does not validate actual FBGEMM conversion/dispatch, natural estimator bias, Torch ABI, or model generation. A 2^24,+1,-2^24 witness separates FP32 cancellation from FP64; a half-step witness distinguishes archived rounding from ties to even.

experiments.paper_location: Sections 4.3 and 4.4; implementation-specific BF16 dot-product boundary support
experiments.mechanism: Actual capability-gated native BF16 QK on complete tiles and explicitly padded partial tiles against FP64 quantized dots; unsupported head dimensions characterized separately.

conditions.execution: actual selected native CPU body, not a software BF16 dot-product emulator
conditions.capabilities: AVX512F, AVX512BW, AVX512BF16 and GCC >=11 confirmed before execution; no FMA requirement
conditions.oracle: Independent arithmetic decoding and FP64 dense dots on identical BF16 keys/query; input quantization error reported separately.
conditions.seed: deterministic fixed exactly representable and nontrivial input families, no RNG
conditions.padded_tail_contract: Accessible initialized IDs and score capacity ceil(nnz/16)*16 required. Source zeros logical scores only and accumulates into seeded padded scores; seeded behavior asserted separately from logical QK correctness.
conditions.dimension_truncation: Safe all-ones buffers reproduce floor(head_dim/32)*32, explicitly differing from complete dense dot.
conditions.storage_adapter: uint16_t alias; input quantizer is a source-derived software model, no FBGEMM conversion runtime

experiments.note: Retains MAGICPIG-BF16-SELECTED-CPU bootstrap trace ID. Padded tails require physical capacity beyond logical nnz and are safe characterization, not exact-length buffer support. Unsupported dimensions silently truncate and are recorded as defects, not accepted dense-dot inputs. No full server BF16 dispatch or extension ABI/linkage claim.
